after.docs/adr/0001-pricing.md:
# ADR-0001: Pricing

## Status

Accepted

## Decision

Charges are computed by the charge function and doubled at the pricing tier.
A café surcharge is never added. Refunds follow the refund function, and the
audit trail is written by audit.

## Consequences

Totals depend on the multiplier.
after.docs/adr/0002-audit.md:
# ADR-0002: Audit

## Decision

Every posting is audited and the audit is kept.

## Notes

Added after the decision.

def audit(entry):
    record = entry
    # keep the trail
    return record
